id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

state.description: The current state value. Changes as the object progresses through Jarvis.

stateHistory.description:
The history of state transition. The most recent state is at the last index and
will have the same value as {@link #state}.
This is managed by the system and should never be set directly.

input.description:
Input data necessary for this specific step's execution; note value is `json` and not `any` because actual value
type may not be known in every App using Jarvis interface

executor.description: If step is RUNNING then executor that is performing the run

actionId.description: The action id of the step execution on the executor.

next.description:
Next step that should be executed by Jarvis after this one. Note that step can only start execution after all other
steps that have it as `#next` are DONE

continueOnUpstreamFailure.description: Wether or not this step should run when an upstream step has a fatal error.

retryOf.description: The previous step in the retry chain. Allows this retry to have access to the error message of the previous retry.

retryCount.description: The current retry count for this step

maxRetries.description: The maximum number of times Jarvis should retry the step.

serverVersion.description: The version of the server to run this step on.

startEnvSpec.description: Lets the service know what type of {@link Env} is needed in order to run properly.

timeout.description: The amount of time to wait for a step to finish before Jarvis aborts it.

title: Jarvis pipeline Step representation including declaration of the step as well as state
name: Jarvis.Step
